The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Havenbound ship carpenter quay bond sees to it, since a bond carpenters lodge after shipyard checks. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Every spiral is counted once. dune stays on the record.
